app.title: TinyLawParody
app.intro: The Office for Everything, filing desk. Write anything to the clerk and the clerk answers with a legal paragraph (in Czech). The clerk is a tiny language model trained from scratch on Czech laws and fairy tales, running only in your browser.
lang.label: Language
chat.label: Conversation with the clerk
chat.welcome: Good day, filing desk. Your submission will be handled in accordance with the regulations. How may I help? (I answer in Czech.)
chat.typing: The clerk is processing your submission…
chat.note_memory: The clerk does not remember earlier messages: each submission is handled on its own. It understands words, not meaning.
chat.placeholder: Write to the clerk… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line)
settings.heading: Settings
status.loading: The clerk is coming to work… (loading the model)
status.loading_progress: The clerk is coming to work… {percent} %
status.generating: The clerk is writing a reply…
status.error: Something went wrong while writing the reply. Please try again.
status.load_error: The model could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
disclaimer.label: Parody.
disclaimer.text: The clerk's replies are machine-generated parody. They are not laws, not quotations of laws and not legal information.
about.heading: About
about.description: A model with about 10 million parameters (a small GPT-style transformer with its own tokenizer), trained from scratch on a CPU. It never learned conversation: each message is given to it as a law title and the start of a paragraph, which it continues.
about.source_laws: Full texts of Czech laws (as of 21 February 2025), dataset roslein/Czech_legal_code on Hugging Face, licence GPL-3.0. The laws themselves are official works not protected by copyright.
about.source_fairy: Czech fairy tales from Czech Wikisource (cs.wikisource.org), public-domain works; for translations the translators are also in the public domain.
about.privacy: The page collects nothing and sends nothing. The model runs only in your browser and the conversation is not stored anywhere. Only your language choice is stored (localStorage).
